semantics.goal: Orient the rigidly attached object for a framed aperture, pass the complete object envelope through it, brake within the exit zone, and hold the requested terminal pose.
excludes: moving above or around the aperture frame
using frame contact as a braking surface
selecting aperture geometry after observing method rankings

evidence: object envelope in the approach corridor
front and rear object extremities cross the aperture plane
object speed below the frozen threshold inside the exit zone

public: tcp and carried-object pose and twist

success: the complete object envelope crosses the aperture without frame contact
the object brakes inside the declared exit zone
the terminal pose and low-velocity hold are completed before timeout
violations: object or robot collision outside declared free space
anti_bypass: require both front and rear object extremities to cross
use solid top and side frame collision geoms
reject paths outside the framed opening
reject arrival after frame contact or without the braking event

requirements: source skill completes alignment, whole-object crossing, braking, and hold in event order
source geometry is feasible for the complete object envelope
qualification includes disjoint initial poses and exact physical replay
source actor and geometry digests are frozen before target development
source_qualification.evidence_resolution: results/arm/obstacle_transfer/validation/aperture_brake/report.json; every control tick, every physics-substep frame-contact event, complete object envelope, braking event, and terminal state; four compressed episodes independently reevaluated

required_signals: aperture-plane crossing for all object extremities

historical_evidence_policy: No historical obstacle-transfer result is an aperture-brake result; the new suite starts with fresh source, development, and heldout evidence.
